response.sql: WITH member_counts AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position) SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, attendance_count * 1.0 / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM member_counts ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;
